text: The animation major is a interdisciplinary field that integrates artistic creativity, technical implementation, and narrative expression. Centered on "dynamic visual creation", it uses methods such as hand-drawing, computer technology, and stop-motion filming to transform static images into visually continuous and dynamic scenes, ultimately forming animation works that can convey stories, emotions, or information. It is widely applied in fields such as film and television, games, advertising, and education, aiming to cultivate comprehensive animation talents with artistic appreciation, creative ability, and technical operation skills.
